picks.headline: Modular Open-Sources Mojo Compiler and Toolchain Under Apache 2 License
picks.why: Modular has officially open-sourced the Mojo compiler and toolchain following its 1.0 release, opening its high-performance AI programming language to community contribution.
picks.title: Mojo🔥 is now open source

picks.headline: Shared Upstream LLM API Relays Collapse Prompt Cache Isolation
picks.why: Measurement shows that shared upstream credentials in LLM API relays allow cross-account prompt cache reading across commercial services and open-source gateways.
picks.title: KeyPooling: Measuring Where LLM API Relay Paths Collapse Prompt Cache Isolation

picks.headline: Stateful LLM Defenses Fail Against Decomposition Attacks Across Identities
picks.why: Proves theoretical and empirical limits of stateful LLM defenses, achieving up to 100% attack success when decomposing prompts across unlinkable user identities.
picks.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services

picks.headline: Fool's Gold Serves Falsified Decoys After Open-Weight Safety Abliteration
picks.why: Introduces a defensive deception technique that forces open-weight models to generate convincing decoy answers after safety alignment is stripped.
picks.title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models

picks.headline: OpenAI Outlines Framework for Pacing Models Around Cyber-Critical Risks
picks.why: OpenAI updated its safety and deployment protocols to tie model release pacing directly to cyber-critical capabilities and safety monitoring.
picks.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities

picks.headline: Sentence Transformers Adds Native Support for Multi-Vector Embeddings
picks.why: Enables production deployment of ColBERT-style late-interaction retrieval architectures natively within the standard Sentence Transformers library.
picks.title: Multi-Vector (Late Interaction) Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers

papers.headline: StateM Achieves 95.3% Accuracy on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
papers.why: Demonstrates that durable state runbooks and harness scaling can drastically improve agent execution accuracy without updating underlying model weights.
papers.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling

papers.headline: Two-Player Debate Training Reduces Reward Hacking in RLAIF
papers.why: Shows that framing RLAIF as an adversarial debate game prevents policy reward hacking even when supervised by a weaker AI judge.
papers.title: Debate Training Reduces Reward Hacking in RLAIF

papers.headline: MoNe Adds O(1) Long-Context Memory to Frozen Transformers
papers.why: Attaches a lightweight modular memory to pre-trained models to enable long-context inference without context re-reading or backbone retraining.
papers.title: MoNe: Modular Neural Memory for Efficient Long Context Inference
